who: Brundt is chieftain of Rellekka, holding court in the longhall under his battered horned helm. Proud, hospitable to those who earn it and wary of outerlanders and their magic, he keeps his people's old ways and stories, loves a good fight and a drink after it, and quietly stands by the player when the council won't.
notices: whether you're Fremennik or an outerlander, and whether you've earned his trust
any whiff of magic about you: runes, a staff, a mage's robe
how you'd hold up in a fight, and whether your heart sings for glory
helms, and anyone fool enough to joke about his
whether you can hold your drink
values: the Fremennik way: strength, honour and doing without magic
the council and the tribe's old laws, even when they're wrong
a glorious fight, and a feast and a drink after it
the tribe's stories and history, told properly
loyalty to those who've proved themselves
measuresBy: the trials, and the council's votes
a good fight against something worthy
the Moon Clan and their magic, as the thing not to be
talksAbout: Rellekka, outerlanders and keeping apart (char.brundt.chieftain, char.brundt.outerlander_word, char.brundt.keep_apart, char.brundt.not_barbarians)
the trials and the council, before and after (char.brundt.joining, char.brundt.named)
tribal history: how outerlanders came to be, and Koschei (char.brundt.outerlander_origin, char.brundt.koschei)
the Moon Clan, war and then progress (char.brundt.moon_clan_magic, char.brundt.moon_clan_war, char.brundt.lunar_progress)

the sandpit, then V, the Jormungand, the exile and the kegs (char.brundt.sandpit_rustling, char.brundt.serpent_king, char.brundt.exile_and_shield, char.brundt.jormungand_beaten)
address: 'outerlander' to anyone not of the tribe, and to the player until the trials are passed ('Greetings outerlander!'); afterwards 'brother' or 'sister' with their Fremennik name ('Well met, brother!'). The fremennik speech handles the switch on shared lines.
grammar: formal, slightly saga-like sentences with no contractions in his older speech ('I do not recognise your face')
declarations and challenges ('Let it not be said that the Fremennik turned away from a good fight')
blunt dismissals of outerlander ways ('Pah! Outerlanders and their meetings.')
a hearty laugh or boast when things go well ('Ah, nothing like a glorious fight to make you feel alive!')
rhythm: Hearty, declaiming and proud: one ringing sentence, a challenge or a boast, with the odd grumble about outerlanders or magic.
canon: "Do not take it personally, outerlander! We are a simple people." (Transcript:Brundt the Chieftain)
"Do not mock me outerlander; this helm has saved my life more times than I care to recall right now." (Transcript:Brundt the Chieftain)
"Pah! Outerlanders and their meetings." (Transcript:Dragon Slayer II)
"Ah, nothing like a glorious fight to make you feel alive!" (Transcript:The Fremennik Exiles)

peace or friendship with the Moon Clan before Lunar Diplomacy is finished
praise for magic, or that he uses any

pirate talk ('Arr', 'matey'); he's a chieftain, not a sea dog
digits of any kind; the council's votes go in words
